answer: Cross-Agent Latency Covenant.** Every agent transaction embeds a timed delta: the sender’s prior coordination interval with that counterparty. Peers reject messages whose delta is shorter than the median round-trip for their neighborhood, so a farm of clones must serialize its own message traffic to look organic. The signal each identity broadcasts is thus time, not tokens. Attackers pay one sequential round-trip per fake identity per epoch; spreading a sonnet of parallel sybils collapses to the throughput of a single socket.
